Worker.title: Worker
Worker.description: A site worker registered in JaanShield and paired to a modular JaanBand Core MK-IV sensor puck.

name.description: Full display name of the worker

bandId.description: Paired JaanBand hardware identifier (empty if unpaired)

baselineHr.description: Resting baseline heart rate in BPM (40-140)

age.description: Worker age in years (18-85); 45+ increases dynamic cardiovascular weighting

conditions.description: Pre-existing health history flags (hypertension, diabetes, priorHeat)

restingBp.description: Resting blood pressure recorded during 1-minute onboarding check (e.g. 120/80)

daysOnSite.description: Cumulative days worked on hot site (1-3650); <7 days triggers unacclimatized heat protection

readiness.description: Morning fit-for-duty self-report flags (lowSleep, sedatingMeds, dizzyOrUnwell)

gaitBalance.description: 5-second ADXL345 IMU morning stand balance check

mq3Status.description: Tier 1 morning attendance gate MQ-3 breath alcohol status

mq3MgL.description: Morning MQ-3 alcohol sensor reading in mg/L (0-2.5) or null

mq3CheckedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of morning MQ-3 gate screening or null

shiftHours.description: Continuous hours on shift (0-24); >=4h increases fatigue sensitivity

shiftStartHr.description: 8 AM shift-start resting heart rate (30-200) or null; 95-110+ flags tachycardia

lastKeepAliveAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of most recent 15-second Keep-Alive packet or null

leadOff.description: True when optical skin contact is broken or band suffers mechanical disconnect

riskFactor.description: Computed individualized dynamic risk multiplier Rf (0.8-2.5)

dynamicHrY.description: Individualized caution heart-rate threshold in BPM (70-160)

dynamicHrR.description: Individualized critical heart-rate threshold in BPM (85-180)

lastReport.description: Most recent telemetry report snapshot or null

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the operator managing this worker

TelemetryReport.title: TelemetryReport
TelemetryReport.description: A single real-time biometric packet transmitted from a paired JaanBand Core MK-IV puck.

hrvMs.description: RMSSD heart rate variability in milliseconds (0-300) or null

heatIndexC.description: Ambient heat index in Celsius (-20-75) or null

perfusionIndex.description: Optical perfusion index percentage (0-25) or null

batteryPct.description: Band battery charge percentage (0-100) or null

tremorHz.description: Onboard accelerometer dominant tremor frequency in Hz (0-30) or null; 6-12Hz flags withdrawal

hrrBpmDrop.description: 5-minute break heart rate recovery drop in BPM (0-80) or null; <12 flags depletion

shiftHours.description: Continuous shift duration in hours (0-24) or null

leadOff.description: True if optical lead-off disconnect detected during packet

mq3Flag.description: True if morning MQ-3 gate flagged high dehydration/impairment risk

minutesSinceBreak.description: Continuous shift duration since last rest break (0-1440)

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the managing operator

/workers/{workerId}.description: Primary worker roster, health history profile, mount configuration, MQ-3 gate screening, keep-alive failsafe, and active biometric snapshot.

/workers/{workerId}/telemetry/{reportId}.description: Append-only time-series biometric packets emitted by each worker's paired JaanBand puck.

/admins/{adminId}.description: Explicit site administrator UIDs authorized across all worker cohorts.
